review_candidates.title: Chief Operating Officer
review_candidates.description: POSITION SUMMARY: The Chief Operating Officer (COO) is a strategic, mission-driven leader responsible for translating the Agency’s mission and strategy into effective, efficient, and sustainable operations. The COO ensures the Agency has the people, systems, infrastructure, technology, data, financial health, and organizational capacity needed to provide high-quality services to clients and community while fostering a strong and supportive organizational culture. As a member of the executive leadership team and key thought partner to the CEO, the COO provides strategic oversight of Finance, Human Resources, Data Services, Information Technology, Facilities & Security, and agency-wide projects and strategic initiatives. The COO aligns people, resources, and operations with organizational priorities and creates the conditions for staff to do their best work and for JFS to achieve meaningful, sustainable impact. The COO brings both strategic discipline, sound judgment, and a strong sense of purpose to the work. They are committed to JFS’s mission and passionate about helping lead a Jewish human services agency. They will ensure organizational priorities are clear, coordinated, and translate into measurable results while cultivating a culture of collaboration, accountability, learning, belonging, trust, and care. The role requires strong data-informed decision-making, financial and operational acumen, systems thinking, project leadership, and a passion for mission-driven human services work. Equally important is the ability to lead with empathy, curiosity, and integrity; listen to the experiences of staff and stakeholders; and use those insights to strengthen systems, decision-making, and outcomes. A central focus of the role is thoughtfully leveraging data, technology, and performance metrics to strengthen organizational effectiveness and improve service delivery. The COO champions thoughtful innovation while ensuring that technology and data are used responsibly, ethically, and in ways that strengthen the human connection at the center of human services. The COO leads implementation of the strategic plan and other cross-agency initiatives, establishing the structures, accountability, and processes needed to move priorities from strategy to action. They develop systems for measuring organizational performance, learning from results, and continuously improving how JFS operates. The COO represents the Agency in the absence of the CEO and serves as an ambassador for JFS’s mission, values, and commitment to staff and community. JFS operates in a hybrid work environment, with a combination of in-office and remote work. Regular travel between Seattle, Kent, and Eastside office locations is expected. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Organizational Strategy, Operations & Performance: Provide leadership and oversight of day-to-day Agency operations and ensure effective coordination across organizational functions. Partner with the CEO and executive team to develop and execute organizational strategy, annual priorities, and operational plans. Translate strategic priorities into measurable objectives, performance indicators, timelines, and accountability structures. Establish systems, dashboards, and reporting processes that provide leadership with a clear view of organizational performance, capacity, risks, and opportunities. Analyze trends across staffing, finances, programs, services, and outcomes to inform decisions and identify opportunities for improvement. Lead efforts to improve processes and workflows, making them more efficient and effective. Work closely with Agency leadership to strengthen cross-departmental collaboration. Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, continuous improvement, and data-informed decision-making. Serve as Lead to designated Board committees and internal working groups. Partner with CPO to align service delivery, resources, and operational priorities with Agency goals. Finance & Resource Management: Partner with the CEO, CFO, CDO, and Board to maintain the Agency’s financial health, sustainability, and responsible stewardship of resources. Oversee annual operating plans and budgets and ensure financial resources are aligned with strategic priorities. Strengthen budget ownership and financial accountability across departments. Use financial information, modeling, and analysis to inform operational decisions, resource allocation, growth, and long-term planning. Ensure financial and operational risks are identified, monitored, and appropriately managed. Oversee the Agency’s insurance coverage and risk exposure to ensure appropriate levels of coverage, renewals, and coordinate with brokers, carriers, and legal counsel. Data, Technology & Data-Driven Leadership Provide strategic oversight of Information Technology and Data Services and ensure technology and data strategies are aligned with Agency priorities, operational needs, and strategic goals. Partner with the Director of Data Services and Information Technology Director to ensure data and technology are managed as core organizational assets and that leaders have timely, accurate, secure, and actionable information to support strategic and operational decision-making. Oversee agency-wide dashboards, scorecards, reporting systems, and performance measures; establish consistent reporting rhythms for the executive team and the Board. Strengthen organizational capacity and data literacy so leaders and managers can effectively interpret and use data. Connect financial, workforce, and service data to identify trends, measure outcomes, and improve organizational performance. Partner with IT and Data Services leadership and agency leaders to strengthen technology adoption, data capabilities, digital tools, and organizational readiness for technology and data-driven change. People & Organizational Culture Partner with Chief People and Culture Officer to strengthen recruitment, retention, compensation, benefits, performance management, employee engagement, professional development, and workforce planning. Foster an organizational culture grounded in respect, belonging, accountability, learning, collaboration, and employee well-being. Support directors and supervisors in building high-performing, collaborative, and accountable teams. Facilities, Security, Risk Management Collaborate with Director of Facilities and Security to ensure Agency work sites are safe, accessible, and secure and provide support for emergency preparedness, workplace safety, business continuity, and continuity of essential operations. Oversee the Agency’s risk management approach, ensuring operational, facilities, technology, data, financial, legal, regulatory, and organizational risks are identified, assessed, prioritized, and appropriately mitigated. Ensure appropriate policies, procedures, and controls are in place to protect people, assets, information, and Agency operations. Agency-Wide Project Management & Strategic Initiatives Provide oversight of agency-wide project management and establish a consistent approach to planning and managing major strategic and operational initiatives. Ensure significant projects have clearly defined objectives, ownership, scope, milestones, resources, budgets, risks, and measures of success and that those objectives and measures of success are achieved. Maintain visibility into the Agency’s portfolio of strategic initiatives and collaborate with the Executive Team to prioritize investments based on strategic value, organizational capacity, financial impact, risk, and expected outcomes. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration and ensure successful transition of completed initiatives into sustainable operations. Executive Leadership & Board Partnership Serve as a member of the executive team and contribute to organization-wide strategy and decision-making. Promote open communication and transparency resulting in optimal information flow throughout the organization. Lead monthly Management Team meetings and staff key board committees, including Governance and Analytics; participate in additional board committees. SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: This COO supervises six positions: Chief Financial Officer Chief People and Culture Officer Director of Facilities and Security Director of Information Technology Director of Data Services Project Manager QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Professional Experience: Minimum of 10 years of progressive management experience, including at least 5 years in senior leadership with broad responsibility for organizational operations and administration. Experience leading multiple organizational functions in a complex environment; experience in human services, healthcare, behavioral health, or mission-driven organizations is preferred. Experience working within a Jewish organization is a plus. Demonstrated success translating organizational strategy into operational plans, measurable goals, and results. Strong financial management experience, including budgeting, resource allocation, and long-term financial planning. Demonstrated ability to use data, performance metrics, and technology to inform decisions and improve organizational outcomes. Experience leading significant organizational change, transformation, or continuous improvement initiatives. Experience successfully managing organization-wide projects and cross-functional initiatives. Experience developing or implementing dashboards, performance measurement systems, or other tools for organizational accountability. Demonstrated understanding of technology and emerging AI capabilities and their potential application to organizational effectiveness. Experience working effectively in a hybrid and/or multi-site environment. Leadership Competencies Strategic and systems thinker who can connect mission, people, resources, operations, and outcomes. Collaborative and proactive leader who serves as an effective thought partner to the CEO and executive team. Ability to translate vision and strategy into clear priorities, action, accountability, and measurable results. Strong analytical, financial, and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment and the ability to make informed decisions in complex situations. Demonstrated ability to lead through change, build trust, and work effectively across diverse teams and perspectives. Innovative and resourceful, with the ability to evaluate new approaches and take calculated risks in support of organizational improvement. Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, both verbal and written. High level of integrity, humility, empathy, accountability, and commitment to continuous learning and improvement. Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Commitment to the mission and values of JFS; familiarity with Jewish community and culture preferred. Technical Skills Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint. Proficiency with project and workflow management tools such as Asana or similar platforms. Demonstrated ability to learn and effectively leverage evolving technology, analytics, automation, and AI tools. EDUCATION: Master’s Degree preferred; Bachelor’s Degree required. An equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered. COMPENSATION: The compensation range for the role is $208,000 to $250,000. We aim to hire new employees in the lower half of the range to allow for future compensation growth. We assess individual pay increases annually as part of our pay adjustment process. We also offer a competitive benefits package for all employees. BENEFITS: Jewish Family Service offers a generous and comprehensive benefits package including: 100% employer-paid premiums for employee medical, dental, life insurance, long-term disability, and employee assistance program. 15 annual vacation days increasing to 20 after 2 years, and generous paid sick time. Paid Federal and Jewish holidays. 5% employer contribution to 401k retirement plan (no employee contribution required). Additional benefits include: vision coverage and FSA enrollment. JFS values and provides opportunities for continued growth and learning for all team members.

review_candidates.title: Enterprise Sales Manager
review_candidates.description: Sales Manager – Enterprise Sales (IT / SaaS / Cloud) About Our Client Our client is a leading global SaaS company specializing in data security, cloud management, governance, and AI solutions for enterprise organizations. Established in 2001, the company serves more than 28,000 customers across over 100 countries, supported by approximately 3,000 employees worldwide. With more than 20 years of strategic partnership with Microsoft, our client has developed strong expertise within the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. Its solutions help organizations securely manage, protect, and recover their data across cloud platforms, including Microsoft, Google, and Salesforce. As the company continues to expand its presence in Korea, it is looking for an experienced Sales Manager to drive new business development and accelerate enterprise growth. About the Position This is a highly commercial, hunter-oriented sales position for an experienced B2B technology sales professional. We are looking for someone who can independently identify and acquire new enterprise customers (New Logo), develop strategic relationships with key decision-makers, and drive complex sales opportunities from initial prospecting through contract closing. Beyond managing existing accounts, the successful candidate will take ownership of their assigned territory, build their own pipeline, and generate new business opportunities through direct engagement with customers and collaboration with strategic partners. This role requires strong frontline sales capabilities, a consultative approach, and the ability to communicate the business value of complex IT and SaaS solutions. Key Responsibilities New Business Development: Identify, prospect, and acquire new enterprise and mid-market customers, generating new business opportunities and securing New Logo accounts. Direct Enterprise Sales: Build and maintain direct relationships with end customers, engaging with key stakeholders and decision-makers to understand their business challenges and requirements. Full Sales Cycle Ownership: Lead the entire sales process, from Prospecting and Opportunity Creation to Solution Proposal, Negotiation, and Closing. Consultative Solution Selling: Understand customers' IT, data management, security, and compliance challenges and position appropriate solutions based on their business needs. Account Development: Expand existing customer relationships through Up-Selling, Cross-Selling, and Renewals. Pipeline & Territory Management: Take ownership of the assigned territory, manage sales pipelines and forecasts, and consistently work toward revenue targets. Internal Collaboration: Work closely with Pre-Sales, Engineering, and Marketing teams to develop tailored proposals and deliver customer value. Partner Development: Collaborate with strategic partners through Partner Enablement and Co-Selling initiatives to generate additional business opportunities. Requirements Must-Have Qualifications Minimum 6 years of B2B Enterprise Sales experience. Proven sales experience in IT / SaaS / Cloud / Security solutions. Strong Hunter profile with a demonstrated track record of acquiring new customers (New Logo), rather than focusing primarily on existing account management. Hands-on frontline sales experience, including direct customer engagement, identifying business challenges, and communicating solution value. Proven ability to independently manage the full sales cycle, from Prospecting and Opportunity Creation to Proposal, Negotiation, and Closing. Strong Direct Sales capabilities, with experience building relationships directly with end customers and leading deals independently, rather than relying primarily on Partners or Distributors. Demonstrated ability to achieve sales quotas and deliver measurable revenue results within enterprise or mid-market customer segments. Preferred Qualifications Experience within the Microsoft 365 ecosystem or Cloud industry. Sales experience in Data Security, Data Management, or Cybersecurity solutions. Experience selling to IT, Security, and Compliance departments and engaging with key decision-makers within enterprise organizations. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is a proactive, commercially driven sales professional who: Enjoys hunting for new business and opening doors to new enterprise customers. Can independently build and manage a sales pipeline rather than depending on inbound leads or an established customer portfolio. Is comfortable engaging directly with senior stakeholders and understanding complex business requirements. Can translate technical solutions into clear business value for customers. Demonstrates strong negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills. Has a strong sense of ownership and thrives in an autonomous, target-driven environment. Working Conditions & Benefits Location: Gangnam-gu, Seoul Working Days: Monday – Friday Working Hours: Flexible start time between 9:00 AM and 10:00 AM Compensation: Negotiable based on experience and qualifications Incentive: Performance-based sales incentive program Recruitment Process CV Screening First Interview – Job-related Interview Second Interview – Culture Fit Interview Compensation Negotiation Final Offer & Onboarding

review_candidates.description: Quem é a pessoa que buscamos? Na Rock Encantech, buscamos uma pessoa desenvolvedora que combine paixão por tecnologia com senso de propósito. Alguém com forte espírito de colaboração, humildade e atitude, que se encante com a excelência e tenha como missão transformar conhecimento em conexões que geram valor. Você será responsável por contribuir com a resiliência e a evolução de aplicações críticas de alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade e grande volume de dados. Por isso, procuramos alguém com base técnica sólida, perfil resolutivo e genuinamente "mão na massa" (aqui não há espaço para "espalhadores de creme"). Se você é um profissional L3 apaixonado por colocar o cliente no centro, que enxerga na dor do usuário uma oportunidade de encantar através da solução e que brilha os olhos ao garantir a estabilidade do produto, seu lugar é com a gente. Estamos passando por um momento crucial de tombamento de produto e modernização de ecossistema, e precisamos de você para liderar essa transição com maestria. Principais responsabilidades: Garantir a sustentação de excelência e a evolução de soluções com processamento em larga escala, atuando diretamente no coração da plataforma; Ser o(a) guardião(ã) da experiência do cliente, investigando a fundo problemas em ambientes produtivos (analisando logs, métricas e rastreamentos) para transformá-los em melhorias definitivas; Apoiar ativamente o processo de tombamento de produto, garantindo a transição segura, a convivência e a modernização de aplicações legadas com foco em resiliência; Lidar de forma pragmática com atividades repetitivas e de alta criticidade, automatizando o que for possível e mantendo o olhar atento à simplicidade e estabilidade; Desenvolver e manter integrações robustas utilizando diferentes modelos de comunicação (REST, mensageria e eventos); Revisar o código de colegas e fornecer feedback construtivo que garanta a aderência às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento; Analisar requisitos de negócio em conjunto com POs e times de produto, traduzindo-os em soluções técnicas sustentáveis; Criar e evoluir interfaces front-end performáticas, seguindo as diretrizes do nosso Design System para entregar uma experiência fluída e funcional; Manter estruturas de dados transacionais e processos de tratamento de informações de acordo com os mais elevados padrões regulatórios e de governança; Colaborar com times de arquitetura, SRE/DevOps e Segurança para garantir boas práticas de compliance, observabilidade e FinOps; Documentar tecnicamente os produtos e os fluxos de tomada de decisão para fomentar a troca de conhecimento no time; Inglês intermediário para leitura e escrita, visando o consumo de documentação técnica diretamente das fontes criadoras. Qualificações Gerais: Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas; Sólido conhecimento em arquitetura de microsserviços, sistemas distribuídos e aplicações multi-tenant; Domínio de boas práticas de engenharia: Clean Code, SOLID, Clean Architecture, DDD, TDD e Event-Driven Architecture; Mentalidade DevOps integrada ao dia a dia: experiência com Docker, conteinerização, ambientes Linux, Git/Gitflow e automação de pipelines CI/CD; Forte experiência em bancos de dados Relacionais e NoSQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis); Cultura de eficiência e inovação: utilização de IA como copiloto no desenvolvimento para garantir padronização, alta cobertura de testes e documentação automatizada; Foco em Privacy by Design e práticas modernas de desenvolvimento seguro. Qualificações Específicas: Poliglotismo Técnico: Proficiência ou forte conhecimento no ecossistema de três linguagens principais, Python, .NET e Java, sendo capaz de navegar e sustentar sistemas construídos nessas tecnologias; Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento Web com PHP, NodeJS (JS e TS) ou outras linguagens modernas de alta performance, utilizando frameworks como Laravel, Symfony, Nest ou Next; Domínio na construção e consumo de APIs REST, incluindo definição de contratos, versionamento e governança; Experiência prática em Cloud AWS, especialmente com os serviços: ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS, API Gateway e SNS; Domínio de ferramentas de mensageria assíncrona (SQS, RabbitMQ ou similares); Domínio em front-end essencial: HTML5, CSS3, ES6+. Qualificações Diferenciais: Experiência anterior com sustentação e modernização de arquiteturas críticas em Marketplaces, E-commerces ou plataformas financeiras de alta performance transacional; Experiência prática na migração real de estruturas de dados e engenharia reversa de sistemas legados; Familiaridade com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) usando AWS CloudFormation ou Terraform. Benefícios que te valorizam Na Rock Encantech, acreditamos no potencial de cada pessoa. Por isso, oferecemos um ambiente dinâmico, inovador e cheio de oportunidades para você crescer e se desenvolver.
